data.body:
## Root-cause analysis (Phase 1 complete — proven, cited)

**Proven root cause (TOCTOU / preexisting omission).** The review-bot casts its
`LLM-Review` vote on whatever revision the queued event names, with **no currency
re-check immediately before the vote is posted**. `app._worker` runs the daa7 staleness
guard (`_superseded_by`) exactly ONCE, *before* the review starts
(`src/rebar/review_bot/app.py`). `voter._review_and_vote` then clones, runs the multi-pass
LLM review (15–45 min on the single serial worker), and calls `post_review` -> `gc.post_vote`
at the END (`src/rebar/review_bot/voter.py:635`) with nothing re-reading the change's current
revision. So a patchset that becomes superseded **during** the review is still voted on.

That vote posts a Gerrit comment on the stale revision. Via g2p's substring mapping
`recheck = verify` on `comment-added` (`infra/gerrit/gerrit_to_platform.ini.template`), the
comment dispatches `.github/workflows/gerrit-verify.yaml` for the STALE refspec
(`refs/changes/25/2225/5`). Because that workflow's concurrency group is keyed by Change-Id
with `cancel-in-progress: true` (`group: gerrit-verify-${{ inputs.GERRIT_CHANGE_ID }}`), the
stale-PS5 run supersedes and cancels the current-PS6 Verified run — exactly the observed
`Canceling since a higher priority waiting request for gerrit-verify-rebar~2225 exists`.

**Proof (runtime, discriminating).** `tests/unit/test_review_bot_stale_vote_baa8.py` drives
the real `voter.review_and_vote` with a Gerrit fake whose current revision (`rev2`) differs
from the reviewed revision (`rev1`). On current `main` the voter STILL casts the vote on the
stale `rev1` (`g.votes == [('rebar~main~Iabc','rev1',1,'[LLM-Review: PASS]...')]`) — RED, the
mechanism firing. Three controls pass and discriminate the fix's contract: still-current ->
votes; current-revision lookup returns `None` -> votes (fail-open); lookup raises -> votes
(fail-open). This rules out "the guard already covers it" (it does not — the guard is
pre-review only) and "any lookup failure would swallow reviews" (fail-open controls green).

**Legitimacy = defect** (auto-fix authorized), against cited authoritative intent:
- daa7 (`oozy-darkish-merganser`) guard docstring names the harm as reviewing "-- and
  **VOTING ON** -- a superseded patchset"; its guard only covers the pre-review window.
- ADR-0009: the bot votes on the **current** revision.
- ADR-0020: a stale/copied CI signal must never stand in for the current patchset's CI
  ("a stale/copied CI vote must never carry onto code CI never ran").
- Precedent `musophobic-secondary-jaguar` (closed) established that a bot-posted comment
  dispatching Verified and cancelling in-flight CI is a defect to prevent; it fixed the
  static-text `recheck` collision. baa8 is the residual: the ordinary review RESULT posted
  on a stale patchset still dispatches Verified. Distinct site, same harm class.

Closing this window RESTORES the daa7-documented invariant; it does not create new gate/vote
precedence policy (no change to the Verified concurrency semantics), so it is a behavior-
restoring `defect`, not a policy decision.

**Defect origin (attribution).** PREEXISTING omission introduced with the voter itself --
story `cogent-strut-kid` (918c-589a-fc4a-4c52), commit `1d1a072a` (2026-06-29, "S4b (918c):
review-bot receiver logic + LLM-Review voter + backfill"): the voter has cast votes without a
pre-cast currency re-check since inception. The date test confirms it: the baa8 evidence is
2026-08-26 **03:33Z**, whereas daa7's staleness guard landed **10:47Z** the same day (commit
`73c45f16`) -- the gap predates daa7. daa7 later closed only the pre-review window; the
during-review/pre-vote window remains. Attributed `caused_by 918c-589a-fc4a-4c52`, class
`preexisting`. (Divergence note: daa7 is the ticket that most recently owned this invariant and
left the during-review window unguarded, but it did not introduce the gap and strictly improved
matters, so it is a related partial mitigation, not the origin.)

**Planned fix (non-test diff ~15 lines, under the 150-line bugfix-size floor -> light tier).**
In `voter._review_and_vote`, immediately before the `post_review` block, re-query the change's
current revision (`gc.get_change_event(change_id)`); if it differs from the reviewed revision,
SUPPRESS the vote (do not call `post_review`, record no dedup), emit an observable diagnostic
recording event-revision/current-revision/event-type/disposition, and return
`{"status":"skipped","reason":"superseded",...}`. Fail OPEN on an unanswerable lookup (mirrors
daa7). `force`/manual-rerun bypass the check (built from the current revision by construction).
RED->GREEN under a held-out oracle.
